Anya: Quick QTR async check-in — 2-min roundup please: what shipped last sprint, what slipped, owners/deps, and any CR pings. I'll collate for the exec rollup.
Carlos: Shipped: runtime-autoscale v3 canary (metrics look solid), Dedicated load-test harness completed. Slipped: private VPC onboarding — network config hold.
Marta: UX shipped chat flow adjustments + prompt tuning A/B. No regressions on our side.
Noah: Infra update: VPC blocker is route table approval (ticket: infra#1837). Waiting on cloud infra team. Owner: @Noah following.
Jin: QA: intermittent seq2seq regressions showing up in quantized runs — tokenizer mismatch suspected. Failing about ~4% of long-sequence tests.
Carlos: @Jin noted. I'll pair with Research on the quantization matrix and tokenization diff. Assigning @Carlos to coordinate.
Marta: CR ping: PR #4523 (chat ux tweaks) needs frontend +1 and backend merge conflict fix before merge.
Anya: I'll do the frontend review today and resolve comments, aiming to merge by EOD.
Noah: Dep note: Dedicated autoscaler depends on infra autoscaling-policy change (PR infra#789). ETA for infra change: tomorrow AM.
DevOps-bot: Deploy notice — canary deploy started: runtime-autoscale-v3 · canary-3 at 2025-11-03T09:12Z :rocket:
Jin: Quick ask: QA cannot sign off private deployment until tokenizer regressions are fixed. Can we prioritize that over onboarding docs?
Carlos: Agree, reprioritizing tokenizer fix to top of sprint. I'll reassign a researcher to help with the tokenizer diffs.
Marta: Next steps (short): 1) @Jin owns tokenizer fix (QA) — investigation + test patch. 2) @Noah chases route-table approval with cloud infra PM. 3) @Anya merges UX CR and resolves backend merge. 4) @Carlos supports quantization RCA and pairs with Research. Target: close these by Friday.
Anya: Will drop a 15-min sync if any item stalls; otherwise I'll post an updated rollup later today.
Noah: I'll tag the cloud infra PM in infra#1837 and escalate if no response by 2pm PST.
Carlos: Thanks — ping this thread when items close and I'll update the OKR milestone doc and flag any ripple effects on capacity/planned rollouts. :thumbsup:
